analysis:
This PR changes docs/reference/configuration.md only. It rewords the intro (head lines 5-10, dropping retained-console and Privy references) and removes the Console UI section (base ~81-99), which covered NEXT_PUBLIC_* build-time public variables. No executable code, keys, wire protocol, attestation, authorization or cache code changes.

The retained provider documentation is unchanged. This includes the prefix-cache and SSD controls relevant to T-041, such as the TTL of at most 1800s, the disk budget and the ephemeral/test-root gating. It also includes add-on hold (TB-012, T-059, T-060), endpoint resumption and logout (A-008, TB-011, T-053), and the App Attest worker opt-ins (exact `1`, not forwarded for the native diagnostic flags). I checked these in the supplied head text and saw no weakening of stated controls and no new attack surface.

The removal is consistent with the provider ownership rescope, which places the console out of scope. The doc now points to the platform configuration reference for coordinator, console and admin settings. Only the first part of the patch excerpt was visible (truncated), and the full Console UI removal in base lines 81-99 was not shown as base text. I treated it as a documentation deletion with no security-control impact. No threat-model update is needed beyond what the existing rescope comments already record.
